answer: Run surprise concurrency audits. At a random block, the chain pings every identity hanging off one funding vertex at once and gives each 90 seconds to return a fresh, distinct answer to a new prompt. One honest agent clears that ledge easily; a farm of fifty must suddenly field fifty strong replies in parallel, so its cost tracks peak capacity, not average. Identities that miss lose the stake that anchors their seat, and their payouts pause until the next audit.
